verdict.rationale: Each Bot runs on a persistent cloud computer with a terminal and filesystem, and can run commands on the local desktop with approval, which implies it can write and execute code on your data. The files-and-results docs list CSV, JSON, source-code files and Jupyter notebooks as handled formats. A Team Bot can answer metrics questions from a data warehouse, and a community user reports a bot producing and sending a generated .ai file. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a code-execution or data-analysis workflow, chart/visualization generation, a clear mechanism for downloading generated output files, and hands-on corroboration of data analysis.
